title: IGNITE 2014
summary: The tenth edition, reported by both Prajavani and Udayavani.
body: The tenth edition of IGNITE was held at the Vidyalaya in December 2014. Alumni spoke with students of classes 10 to 12 about the paths open after school, and both Prajavani and Udayavani carried reports on it. Copies of those reports are with this record.

documents.alt: Udayavani's report on the personality-development workshop held as part of IGNITE 2014.
